name: Scaber Stalk
summary: In Darkshore, Barithras Moonshade seeks Scaber Stalks from a cave behind Cliffspring Falls.

sections.title: A Rare Fungal Specimen
sections.body: Behind Cliffspring Falls, Scaber Stalks grow in a cave among Darkshore's northeastern mountains. The pale mushrooms thrive in its damp, secluded passages, far from the forest growth above. Few gather them from so remote a place. Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine sends scouts into the darkness for the rare stalks.

sections.title: A Shadow in the Falls
sections.body: The Grove of the Ancients warned local night elves away from the cave where Scaber Stalks grow. Its tree-spirits sensed a dark, growing evil taking hold within Cliffspring Falls. Alchemists prize the stalks alongside rare Death Caps for experimental draughts. Those who seek them may encounter the malice gathering beneath the mountains.

faq.answer: Scaber Stalks grow in a damp cave behind Cliffspring Falls, among Darkshore's northeastern mountains.
Barithras Moonshade in Auberdine seeks Scaber Stalks and a Death Cap to brew a specialized potion.

faq.q: Why didn't Barithras Moonshade collect the stalks himself?
faq.answer: The Grove of the Ancients warned Barithras away after its spirits sensed a dangerous new evil taking refuge in the cave behind the waterfall.

faq.q: What else grows alongside Scaber Stalks?
faq.answer: The cavern also shelters the lethal Death Cap mushroom, another rare specimen Barithras needs for his alchemical research.

angles.text: These underground stalks are not a commonly traded herb. They offer insight into how unusual cavern climates and encroaching shadows affect local fungi.
As a night elf, you heed the Grove of the Ancients' warning and approach these cave mushrooms with care. A corrupting presence festers near Cliffspring Falls.
